rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial word for a clock when the context makes the meaning clear.

example.english: The clock in the living room is five minutes slow.
example.traditional: 客廳嗰個鐘慢咗五分鐘。
example.jyutping: haak3 teng1 go2 go3 zung1 maan6 zo2 ng5 fan1 zung1

rows.note: Use this when you want to say explicitly that the device is a timekeeping clock rather than relying on context.

example.english: The clock in the room has run out of power.
example.jyutping: gaan1 fong2 ge3 si4 zung1 mou5 din6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a timepiece considered as part of the general clock-and-watch category, especially in technical or commercial contexts.

example.english: This shop specializes in clock and watch products.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 zyun1 maai6 zung1 biu1
